companion_templates.lightweightMicrocontrollerForTelemetryBr: Lightweight microcontroller for telemetry bridges and sensor hubs
companion_templates.fullCompanionComputerForVideoAutonomy: Full companion computer for video, autonomy, and advanced features
companion_templates.gpuAcceleratedCompanionForAiComputer: GPU-accelerated companion for AI, computer vision, and SLAM
companion_templates.budgetFriendlyPiAlternativeWithSimilar: Budget-friendly Pi alternative with similar capabilities
companion_templates.replaceSikRadioWithWifiTelemetry: Replace SiK radio with WiFi telemetry. Connect QGroundControl, Mission Planner, or ArduDeck wirelessly.
companion_templates.connectionlessEncryptedTelemetryUpTo1km: Connectionless encrypted telemetry up to 1km range. Requires ESP32 on both air and ground side.
companion_templates.lightweightSerialToWifiBridgeMinimal: Lightweight serial-to-WiFi bridge. Minimal firmware for simple telemetry forwarding over UDP.
companion_templates.ntripServerClientAndCasterOn: NTRIP server, client and caster on an ESP32. Puts a base receiver on the network, or pulls corrections down on the vehicle, with no laptop in the field.
companion_templates.mavlinkRouterWifiApConnectsGround: MAVLink router + WiFi AP. Connects ground stations wirelessly without a telemetry radio.
companion_templates.cameraStreamingWithGstreamerMavlinkRouti: Camera streaming with GStreamer + MAVLink routing. Low-latency H.264 video over WiFi.
companion_templates.fullFeaturedCompanionWithWebUi: Full-featured companion with web UI. Telemetry routing, video streaming, NTRIP, and network management.
companion_templates.dockerBasedCompanionOsWithExtension: Docker-based companion OS with extension store. Full vehicle management, video, and third-party extensions.
companion_templates.pythonEnvironmentWithMavsdkForOnboard: Python environment with MAVSDK for onboard autonomous missions. Run scripts without a GCS link.
companion_templates.digitalFpvSystemHdVideoTelemetry: Digital FPV system: HD video + telemetry + RC over WiFi broadcast. Up to 50km range.
companion_templates.baseSideReadsRtcm3OffThe: Base side: reads RTCM3 off the receiver and pushes it to an NTRIP caster. Headless, reconnects on its own, no GUI anywhere.
companion_templates.vehicleSidePullsCorrectionsFromA: Vehicle side: pulls corrections from a caster and injects them as GPS_RTCM_DATA straight into the flight controller. Nothing on the ground has to stay connected.
companion_templates.gpuAcceleratedObjectDetectionAndTracking: GPU-accelerated object detection and tracking with YOLO. Real-time obstacle avoidance and target following.
